violation_type.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio for Field Trips - Areas Open to General Public (26 TAC §747.1901(a))
violation_type.short_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio for Field Trips - Areas Open to General Public
violation_type.typical_finding: Four children and one caregiver took a field trip to a public park. The youngest child in the group was 21 months.      The deficiency was corrected during the inspection as the children and caregiver left the park and returned to the home.
